title: APPEAL/1/2025 — SNG REAL ESTATE PRIVATE LIMITED vs. AADITYA ARYA SONI
text:
Court of Registrar
DEBTS RECOVERY TRIBUNAL, JAIPUR
APPEAL
SNG REAL ESTATE PVT LTD
V/S
ADITYA ARYA SONI COMMISSIONER
ITEM NO.26
Diary No- 145/2025
Dated: -30-01-2025
Shri Naresh Kumar Sejvani counsel for the applicant is present.
As per office report application barred by limitation but applicant has
filed an application under section 5 of limitation act. Now Appeal be
registered subject to preserved right of respondent on limitation point.
The matter be listed before the Hon’ble Presiding Officer on 05.02.2025
for arguments on application of u/s 5 of limitation act.
Registrar (I/C)
9
